decisions.reason: After only one year, little is known about the carpet's value, and keeping a catalogue item listed costs little, so the option stays open.
A hand-knotted wool silk carpet is a high-value premium item whose demand is still uncertain, and keeping it on its own page costs little.
The prospects of this low-pile decorative carpet are not yet resolved and its holding costs are low, so dropping it now would be premature.
The corner bench is a furniture item with a longer sales cycle, so one year does not reveal enough to justify abandoning it.
As one of several similar low-pile carpets, it carries some overlap risk, but there is no evidence yet against keeping this cheap option open.
The swivel shell chair is still in its early market phase with uncertain value and low ongoing cost, so management keeps the option.
